# Grime cursor map

`makePS1Material` hands flat-coloured materials one of 4 grime maps in creation order (`grimeCursor++ % 4`).
To stay 1:1 without recreating every object in the HTML's exact order, each native section calls
`PS1.syncGrime(n)` with the HTML's cursor at that section's first grime use.

Recorded from an instrumented run of `src/ps1_bedroom.html` (source line : cursor at the first grime use on that line).
Vehicle bodies are picked at random in the HTML, so the counts drift after line 3867 from run to run; trees (3987)
onward are still listed as recorded.
